chunks.content: 96 You totally don’t have to do this, for real no pressure at all. But if you’re feeling generous (or maybe bored) today, I could use your help. At deal academy, we want to help you buy an accounting firm. But in order to do that I could use help knowing what you want! So here’s a one-question-only survey. It should take you less than a minute to fill out. You’re more than welcome to take your time with the question, but an off the top of your head answer is great, too. Thanks Sara, I really appreciate having you in my network. Thanks! Sara Sharp Deal Attorney Instructor p.s. Why are accountants so calm and collected?... They have great internal controls.
